title: South Korea’s Biggest Bank Taps JPMorgan Blockchain for Trade Payments
excerpt: KB Kookmin Bank will launch dollar trade payments on JPMorgan's Kinexys blockchain in August, covering 10 countries.
content_html:
Kamina Bashir

Sun, July 26, 2026 at 2:00 PM EDT 1 min read

KB Kookmin Bank will launch a blockchain payment service for import and export companies in August. 

The bank will initially process US dollar payments for those clients over JPMorgan's Kinexys network. It announced the plan on July 26.

South Korean Bank Moves Dollar Trade Payments Onto JPMorgan Blockchain

Kinexys is JPMorgan's blockchain unit, formerly known as Onyx. It runs institutional payments, tokenization, and digital asset settlement.

The platform has processed more than $4 trillion since its launch. Average daily transactions exceed $7 billion.

The service will initially support dollar remittances to 10 countries, including South Korea, according to local media reports. The list covers the US, Singapore, Saudi Arabia, India, Thailand, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, and South Africa. Korean branches and KB Kookmin's Singapore office will offer the service. 

Follow us on X to get the latest news as it happens

This comes just days after KB Kookmin was selected for a government-backed deposit token payment project. The Ministry of Science and ICT and the Korea Internet & Security Agency run the program.

Whether other Korean lenders adopt Kinexys will test how far tokenized deposits reach beyond JPMorgan's clients.

content_html_zh:
卡米纳·巴希尔

2026 年 7 月 26 日星期日，美国东部时间下午 2:00 阅读 1 分钟

KB国民银行将于8月为进出口公司推出区块链支付服务。

该银行最初将通过摩根大通的 Kinexys 网络为这些客户处理美元付款。 它于7月26日宣布了该计划。

韩国银行将美元贸易支付转移到摩根大通区块链上

Kinexys 是摩根大通的区块链部门，以前称为 Onyx。 它运行机构支付、代币化和数字资产结算。

该平台自推出以来已处理超过 4 万亿美元。 日均交易额超过 70 亿美元。

据当地媒体报道，该服务最初将支持向包括韩国在内的 10 个国家进行美元汇款。 该名单涵盖美国、新加坡、沙特阿拉伯、印度、泰国、卡塔尔、阿拉伯联合酋长国、巴林和南非。 韩国分行和 KB Kookmin 新加坡办事处将提供该服务。

在 X 上关注我们以获取最新消息

就在几天前，KB Kookmin 被选为政府支持的存款代币支付项目。 该计划由科学和信息通信技术部以及韩国互联网安全局负责运营。

其他韩国银行是否采用 Kinexys 将考验代币化存款对摩根大通客户的影响程度。
